You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def bands_of(gin):
    H=len(gin); W=len(gin[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gin for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fgc=[k for k in cnt if k!=bg][0]
    pat=[r for r in range(H) if any(v!=bg for v in gin[r])]
    runs=[];cur=[pat[0]]
    for r in pat[1:]:
        if r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: runs.append(cur);cur=[r]
    runs.append(cur)
    return bg,fgc,runs

def apply_rule(gin, direction, thresh_mode):
    """direction: 'B2A' or 'A2B'. thresh_mode: 'eq','ge' — source shifted row must reach W-1."""
    bg,fgc,runs = bands_of(gin)
    H,W=len(gin),len(gin[0])
    trs,brs = runs[0],runs[1]
    src,drs = (brs,trs) if direction=='B2A' else (trs,brs)
    dr = drs[0]-src[0]
    # best dc by overlap
    best=None
    for dc in range(-W,W):
        ov=sum(1 for r in src for c in range(W) if gin[r][c]==fgc and 0<=c+dc<W and gin[r+dr][c+dc]==fgc)
        if best is None or ov>best[0]: best=(ov,dc)
    ov,dc=best
    out=[row[:] for row in gin]
    marks=[]
    for r in src:
        cells=[c for c in range(W) if gin[r][c]==fgc]
        if not cells: continue
        mx=max(cells)+dc
        hit = (mx==W-1) if thresh_mode=='eq' else (mx>=W-1)
        if not hit: continue
        for c in cells:
            c2=c+dc
            if 0<=c2<W and gin[r+dr][c2]==bg:
                out[r+dr][c2]=1; marks.append((r+dr,c2))
    return out, sorted(marks), (dr,dc)

for name,(di,do) in {'d1':(d1i,d1o),'d2':(d2i,d2o)}.items():
    for direction in ['B2A','A2B']:

            out,marks,shift = apply_rule(di,direction,tm)
            ok = out==do
            print(name,direction,tm,'shift',shift,'marks',marks,'MATCH' if ok else 'no')

def bands_rows(g):
    bgc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fgc=[c for c,_ in Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common() if c!=bgc][0]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if fgc in r]
    # group contiguous
    groups=[];cur=[rows[0]]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: groups.append(cur);cur=[r]
    groups.append(cur)
    return bgc,fgc,groups

def solve3v(g, global_dc=False):
    bgc,fgc,gr = bands_rows(g)
    top,bot = gr[0],gr[-1]
    dr = bot[0]-top[0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # global dc from band overlap
    bestg=max(((sum(1 for r in top for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==fgc and 0<=c+dd<len(g[0]) and g[r+dr][c+dd]==fgc),dd) for dd in range(-len(g[0]),len(g[0]))))
    gdc = bestg[1]
    for r in top:
        W=len(g[0])
        src=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==fgc]
        tgt_r=r+dr
        tgt=[c for c in range(W) if g[tgt_r][c]==fgc]
        if not src or not tgt: continue
        if global_dc: dc=gdc
        else:
            dc=max(range(-W,W), key=lambda dd: sum(1 for c in src if 0<=c+dd<W and g[tgt_r][c+dd]==fgc))
        for c in src:
            c2=c+dc
            if 0<=c2<W and g[tgt_r][c2]==bgc and c2>max(tgt):
                out[tgt_r][c2]=1
    return out
